title: Instrument a Pipeline the Way On-Call Will Query It
objective: Emit freshness, volume, error or reject count, and lag or watermark delay for a real run, correlate logs with a run_id, and write one paging alert and one silent alert with numeric thresholds.
whyThisMatters: Service CPU is the wrong graph. On-call for a pipeline asks: is the 09:00 publish late, did we drop more than one percent, is the stream lagging the source? If those questions need a human to read a stack trace, the instrumentation is not done.
evidence: Captured values from one real run for freshness, volume, errors or rejects, and lag or watermark delay
At least four structured log lines from that run sharing one run_id
An alert-policy note with one paging threshold and one non-paging threshold, both numeric
Two operational queries or commands with captured output: load lateness, and drop rate
Reflection notes answering the task questions
acceptanceCriteria: Four named metrics exist with captured values from a real run: freshness, volume, error or reject count, and lag or watermark delay.
Every submitted log line from one run shares one run_id, and at least four such lines are included.
The alert-policy note states one paging condition and one non-paging condition, each with a numeric threshold.
Two operational questions — whether a named load is late, and whether drop rate exceeded one percent — have a query or command and captured output.
